svg.title: How it runs
svg.desc: Four stacked layers: the plugin layer (built-in Bika and JM plus your own JS) feeds the Rust-side windcore — QuickJS sandbox, reqwest, decoding, archives, video — which reaches the Flutter UI through flutter_rust_bridge: workspace, discovery, reader, bookshelf, settings.
